idea-plugin.name: Thread-Confinement Escape Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a mutable local variable (List/ Map/Set) captured by a task handed to a background thread (ExecutorService.submit/execute, new Thread(...).start()) that the SAME method also touches afterward outside any synchronized block -- real shared mutable state with no real protection (CWE-362/366). Java has no language-level way to enforce thread confinement, which is exactly the gap a static analyzer needs to cover.

Real escape analysis over a boundary this catalog has never analyzed before: which outer-scope variables a lambda/anonymous class body actually CAPTURES (the opposite of what this catalog's interprocedural analyzers do when they deliberately refuse to descend into a lambda body at all).

Stated honestly: v0.1 only `List`/`Map`/`Set` local variables declared in the same method; only an inline lambda or anonymous class passed directly at the call site. No dedicated Marketplace plugin found for this exact angle.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Mutable state shared with a background thread without synchronization
